# Now 2.13.35
- Lyrics now size themselves to the width of the space they have, not just its height. On a narrower or higher density display the text was staying nearly as large while having far less room, so lines wrapped about a quarter sooner and two line lyrics became three. Each extra wrapped row is more work for the compositor, which is what made long lines feel choppy on a laptop display while a wider external one stayed smooth. Lines now wrap at a similar point on any display. Wider displays are unaffected.

# Now 2.13.34
- Fixed the remaining stutter on line changes, which was most noticeable when the outgoing and incoming lines were both long enough to wrap. The current line was being scaled up slightly as it took focus, and scaling text that is also blurred forces it to be redrawn on every frame of the transition, with the cost rising as the lines get longer. Focus is now carried by brightness and sharpness alone, and the fade is composited rather than redrawn, so nothing is re-rendered mid-transition regardless of how long the lines are.

# Now 2.13.33
- Fixed the jitter that only appeared when the incoming line was long enough to wrap onto two rows. Such a line could change height at the exact moment it became the current line, which moved the scroll target while the view was still animating toward it. Lines short enough to fit on one row were never affected, which is why the transition felt smooth for some lines and not others. Line heights are now fixed regardless of which line is playing.
